items.title: Simulating microplastic distribution in oceans: the impact of morphology and sources
items.title_en: Simulating microplastic distribution in oceans: the impact of morphology and sources
items.title_zh: 模拟海洋中微塑料的分布：形态和来源的影响
items.summary_en: Microplastics are widespread in the ocean with known accumulation hotspots in the subtropical gyres, yet their horizontal and vertical distribution is not fully understood. Microplastics are found under various shapes and sizes, reflecting multiple sources. This morphological variability influences their ocean distribution and hence needs to be considered in global models. Here, we studied the influence of microplastic morphology on its global oceanic distribution with the global numerical model NEMO/PISCES-PLASTIC. We explicitly simulated the ocean distribution of microplastics of different morphologies (fibres versus fragments) reflecting their source categories (laundry and household dust fibres, personal care products, car tyre wear, fragments from larger objects) and source vectors (rivers and continental runoff). Our results demonstrate that accounting for the variability in microplastics vertical behaviour linked with their morphology significantly influences the global spatial distribution and budgets of microplastics. Furthermore, our results indicate that fibres, that constitute a large proportion of the primary MPs, are the dominant microplastics in the mesopelagic layer (100–1000 m water depth). Finally, global microplastic budget derived from our model simulations show that it is essential to consider in situ fragmentation of macroplastics into microplastics to reconcile the latest assessment of microplastic sources in the ocean with existing estimates of the ocean microplastic budget. These conclusions have strong implications for marine plastic pollution assessments and mitigation measures.
items.summary_zh: 微塑料在海洋中广泛存在，已知在亚热带环流区存在富集热点，但其水平和垂直分布尚不完全清楚。 微塑料呈现出各种形状和大小，反映了其来源的多样性。这种形态上的多样性影响着它们在海洋中的分布，因此在全球模型中必须予以考虑。在此，我们利用全球数值模型NEMO/PISCES-PLASTIC，研究了微塑料形态对其全球海洋分布的影响。 我们明确模拟了不同形态（纤维与碎片）微塑料在海洋中的分布，这些形态反映了其来源类别（洗衣和家庭灰尘中的纤维、个人护理产品、汽车轮胎磨损、较大物体的碎片）以及来源路径（河流和大陆径流）。 研究结果表明，考虑与形态相关的微塑料垂直行为的变异性，会显著影响微塑料的全球空间分布和通量。 此外，我们的结果表明，纤维作为初级微塑料的主要组成部分，是中层海域（水深 100–1000 米）中占主导地位的微塑料。 最后，基于本模型模拟得出的全球微塑料收支表明，为使最新的海洋微塑料来源评估与现有的海洋微塑料收支估算相一致，必须考虑宏观塑料在原位碎裂成微塑料的过程。这些结论对海洋塑料污染评估及减缓措施具有重要启示。

items.title: Future energy transition mineral demands and barriers for south and Southeast Asia
items.title_en: Future energy transition mineral demands and barriers for south and Southeast Asia
items.title_zh: 南亚和东南亚未来能源转型对矿产的需求及面临的障碍
items.summary_en: While the global geological availability of critical minerals is likely sufficient to support energy transition efforts, geographically imbalanced energy transition mineral production and consumption raise concerns around supply chain disruption and import dependence. While regions like Europe and the United States are actively studying such vulnerabilities, they remain relatively underexplored for emerging economies. This study uses a new, customizable mineral demand model for a wide set of commodities to estimate future energy transition mineral demand in the power generation and transport sectors for India, Bangladesh, and countries in ASEAN. Results indicate that ASEAN and South Asia may become significant consumers by 2050 on par with developed economies like the United States. In many cases, current mining in South and Southeast Asia falls short of projected regional demands. Both regions lack requisite graphite and lithium production. South Asia faces additional nickel, rare earths, copper, polysilicon, and cobalt deficits. Our results identify mineral supply-demand imbalances that may present future tradeoff risks between import dependence, downstream clean technology manufacturing ambitions, and public policy efforts to secure energy transition mineral supplies. Such results pose important implications particularly for countries like India, Vietnam, and Indonesia seeking to develop domestic solar, battery, and electric vehicle industries. This analysis highlights the need for emerging economies to proactively assess the mineral security considerations of national goals and to adopt efforts including recycling, energy efficiency, materials research and substitution, international cooperation, and mining and processing project development to alleviate supply-demand imbalances.
items.summary_zh: 尽管全球关键矿产的储量可能足以支撑能源转型，但能源转型所需矿产的产销地域分布不均，引发了人们对供应链中断和进口依赖的担忧。虽然欧洲和美国等地区正在积极研究此类脆弱性，但对于新兴经济体而言，这方面仍相对缺乏研究。 本研究采用一种适用于多种大宗商品的新型可定制矿产需求模型，估算了印度、孟加拉国及东盟各国在发电和交通运输领域未来对能源转型矿产的需求。结果表明，到2050年，东盟和南亚可能成为与美国等发达经济体相当的重要消费地区。 在许多情况下，南亚和东南亚当前的采矿产量无法满足预计的区域需求。这两个地区都缺乏必要的石墨和锂产量。南亚还面临镍、稀土、铜、多晶硅和钴的额外短缺。 我们的研究结果揭示了矿产供需失衡现象，这可能在未来引发进口依赖、下游清洁技术制造目标以及确保能源转型矿产供应的公共政策举措之间的权衡风险。这些结果对印度、越南和印度尼西亚等致力于发展国内太阳能、电池和电动汽车产业的国家具有重要启示。 本分析强调，新兴经济体有必要主动评估国家目标中的矿产安全考量，并采取包括回收利用、提高能效、材料研究与替代、国际合作以及矿产开采和加工项目开发等措施，以缓解供需失衡。

items.title: Radiative impacts of a compound dust-and-rain-on-snow event in Michigan’s Upper Peninsula
items.title_en: Radiative impacts of a compound dust-and-rain-on-snow event in Michigan’s Upper Peninsula
items.title_zh: 密歇根州上半岛一次复合型“雪上尘雨”事件的辐射影响
items.summary_en: Dust deposition and rain on snow events can significantly alter surface albedo and drive melt processes. When combined, they can become a powerful catalyst of rapid meltwater generation. A unique coupled dust and rain-on-snow (ROS) event in March 2025 with dust sourced from the Central and Southern US Plains substantially altered the surface energy balance of snow in the Upper Peninsula of Michigan. Using a combination of field-based observations (spectral snow albedo, liquid water content, and snow depth) and radiative transfer modeling, we analyze the impact of this unique event on snowpack evolution. At the onset of rainfall, the broadband albedo dropped rapidly, starting at 0.65 prior to the event and reaching as low as 0.52 prior to fresh snowfall. When the dust-laden surface was exposed, we determined that the added radiative forcing due to dust presence could result in an additional melt of 4.5–7.8 mm water equivalent/day above expectation under observed ambient conditions. The peak radiative forcing of 105 W m−2 is comparable to other major dust events in the European Alps, which have similarly distant dust sources. To our knowledge, these are the first reported measurements of the radiative impacts of these dusty ROS events. As dust sources become more prevalent, this type of event may become more common around the globe. Even if short lived, the potential for rapid snowmelt enhanced by these events can cause flooding and hazards for infrastructure and are therefore important to understand for risk mitigation.
items.summary_zh: 粉尘沉积和降雪后降雨事件会显著改变地表反照率，并驱动融雪过程。 二者结合时，可成为引发快速融水生成的强力催化剂。2025年3月发生了一次独特的尘埃与降雪伴随降雨（ROS）耦合事件，尘埃源自美国中部和南部平原，该事件显著改变了密歇根州上半岛积雪表面的能量平衡。 通过结合实地观测（雪谱反照率、液态水含量和积雪深度）与辐射传输建模，我们分析了这一独特事件对积雪演变的影响。 降雨开始时，宽带反照率迅速下降，从事件发生前的0.65降至新雪降落前的0.52。 当布满尘埃的表面暴露出来时，我们确定，在观测到的环境条件下，尘埃的存在所导致的额外辐射强迫可能会导致比预期多出 4.5–7.8 毫米水当量/天的融雪量。 105 W m−2 的峰值辐射强迫与欧洲阿尔卑斯山脉的其他重大沙尘事件相当，这些事件的沙尘来源同样遥远。 据我们所知，这是首次报告关于此类含尘ROS事件辐射影响的测量结果。随着尘源日益普遍，此类事件在全球范围内可能变得更加常见。即使持续时间较短，这些事件加剧的快速融雪仍可能引发洪水并危及基础设施，因此，为降低风险，理解其影响至关重要。

items.title: Mapping agricultural dynamics in displacement-affected landscapes using satellite foundation model embeddings
items.title_en: Mapping agricultural dynamics in displacement-affected landscapes using satellite foundation model embeddings
items.title_zh: 利用卫星基础模型嵌入技术，绘制受流离失所影响地区农业动态图
items.summary_en: Sub-Saharan Africa already faces low human development, extreme climate risks, and environmental degradation–pressures compounded by large-scale population displacement resulting from armed conflict. Nowhere are these intersecting challenges more evident than in Uganda, which currently hosts the largest refugee population in Africa (nearly 2 million), straining land management, natural resources, and local food systems. As is common across displacement settings, spatially explicit baseline agricultural data in Uganda’s refugee-hosting regions remain scarce, limiting land-use planning, food security assessments, and humanitarian interventions. We present the first high-resolution assessment of cropland dynamics across refugee settlements in northern Uganda (2017–2024) using satellite foundation model embeddings and machine learning. We leveraged Google’s 10 m AlphaEarth Foundation embeddings with Random Forest classification to generate annual cropland maps, and applied sample-based accuracy assessment and area estimation to quantify uncertainty. Overall classification accuracy ranged from 0.75 to 0.87 (F1-scores: 0.65–0.84). Area-adjusted estimates revealed pronounced interannual variability: rapid expansion from 2017 to 2019, contraction in 2020 coinciding with COVID-19 disruptions and flooding events, a peak extent in 2022 (447,809 12,733 ha), and a marked decline by 2024 (223,159 9,744 ha) coinciding with humanitarian aid funding cuts and drought events. To quantify drivers of these dynamics, we fit a linear mixed-effects model relating cropland cover to distance from settlement boundaries, rainfall and temperature anomalies, and year. Cropland cover declined significantly with distance from settlement boundaries ( , ) and was positively associated with rainfall anomalies ( , ), while temperature anomaly was not a significant predictor. These results provide quantitative evidence that settlement proximity and rainfall deficits are associated with observed cropland dynamics, though the observational design does not establish causality. By integrating foundation-model representations with rigorous uncertainty quantification and driver analysis, we provide settlement-scale evidence to inform land-use planning, food security assessments, and humanitarian interventions in fragile, displacement-affected landscapes.
items.summary_zh: 撒哈拉以南非洲地区已经面临人类发展水平低下、极端气候风险和环境退化等问题——而武装冲突导致的大规模人口流离失所，进一步加剧了这些压力。 在乌干达，这些相互交织的挑战表现得最为明显。该国目前收容着非洲最多的难民（近200万人），这给土地管理、自然资源和当地粮食系统带来了巨大压力。 与所有流离失所情境一样，乌干达收容难民地区的空间明确的农业基线数据仍然稀缺，这限制了土地利用规划、粮食安全评估和人道主义干预。 我们利用卫星基础模型嵌入技术和机器学习，首次对乌干达北部各难民营的农田动态（2017–2024 年）进行了高分辨率评估。 我们利用谷歌的 10 米分辨率 AlphaEarth 基础模型嵌入数据结合随机森林分类算法生成年度农田分布图，并通过基于样本的准确率评估和面积估算方法来量化不确定性。 总体分类准确率在0.75至0.87之间（F1分数：0.65–0.84）。 经面积校正的估算结果显示出显著的年际变异性：2017年至2019年期间快速扩张，2020年因新冠疫情扰动和洪灾事件而萎缩，2022年达到峰值（447,809 12,733 公顷）， 并于2024年出现显著下降（223,159 9,744公顷），这与人道主义援助资金削减及干旱事件同时发生。为量化这些动态的驱动因素，我们建立了一个线性混合效应模型，将农田覆盖率与距聚居地边界的距离、降雨和温度异常以及年份相关联。 耕地覆盖率随距聚居地边界的距离增加而显著下降（ , ），并与降雨异常呈正相关（ , ），而温度异常并非显著预测因子。这些结果提供了定量证据，表明聚居地邻近程度和降雨亏缺与观测到的耕地覆盖率变化相关。

items.title: Public subsidies and insurance-based incentives for green roof adoption
items.title_en: Public subsidies and insurance-based incentives for green roof adoption
items.title_zh: 针对推广绿色屋顶的公共补贴和基于保险的激励措施
items.summary_en: Green roofs are a promising urban nature-based solution to reduce multi-hazard climate risks, but their adoption remains limited due to high costs and misaligned incentives. This study examines the relative effectiveness of monetary incentives in promoting green roof adoption, with the aim of identifying which policy approaches are most effective in increasing uptake. We conducted a survey experiment among 1564 Dutch households that captures stated green roof adoption intention, when exposed to different financial incentives, in the context of multiple hazards. Net present value comparisons indicate that subsidies are the most effective incentive per euro, followed by premium discounts. Perceived response costs strongly constrain uptake, and knowledge-based interventions that enhance perceived efficacy and lower procedural barriers can match the impact of substantial subsidies. Our contributions highlight the value of policy mixes that combine financial and behavioural levers, while also demonstrating the potential of insurance-based incentives as an effective complement to public subsidies for supporting urban climate adaptation.
items.summary_zh: 绿色屋顶是降低多重气候灾害风险的一种极具前景的城市自然解决方案，但由于成本高昂和激励机制不合理，其推广应用仍较为有限。本研究考察了货币激励在促进绿色屋顶应用方面的相对有效性，旨在确定哪些政策措施最能有效提高绿色屋顶的采用率。 我们针对1564户荷兰家庭开展了一项调查实验，在多重灾害背景下，通过不同财务激励措施，捕捉受访者对绿色屋顶的明确采用意向。净现值比较表明，按每欧元计算，补贴是最有效的激励措施，其次是保费折扣。 感知到的响应成本严重制约了采用率，而那些能够提高感知效力和降低程序性障碍的知识型干预措施，其效果可媲美大额补贴。本研究的贡献在于突显了将财务和行为杠杆相结合的政策组合的价值，同时证明了基于保险的激励措施作为公共补贴的有效补充，在支持城市气候适应方面具有潜力。

items.title_zh: 17亿年前的化石揭示了复杂生命起源的关键线索
items.summary_en: Scientists studying ancient Australian rocks uncovered more than 12,000 fossils from some of the oldest known eukaryotes on Earth. These early complex cells lived in settings ranging from coastal mudflats to the open sea, but only where oxygen was available. Oxygen-free environments contained simpler microbes instead. The findings strengthen the idea that oxygen played a crucial role in the emergence of complex life.
